root.title: Calibration layer: miss categories, real metrics, pre-registered predictions, honest actuals (calibration-metrics-spec 2026-09-02)

predictions.approach: Implement docs/design/calibration-metrics-spec.md sections 2.1-2.6 as five leaves: ledger + prediction_id (M1), honest actuals (M2), miss_category (M3), metrics in reflect summarize + scorecard (M4), nudges (M5), docs (M6). Pre-auth lanes are spec-only (2.7) and have no leaf. Sonnet executors, tests pin formulas against synthetic corpora.
predictions.pre_mortem: The formulas get implemented against wall-clock duration because active_min lands late; sequence M2 in group 1 so M4 can prefer it. Second risk: confidence proves to be noise against held - that is a valid finding, not a failure; report it, don't tune the map to hide it.

prd.title: PRD: clawpm calibration metrics and miss-category taxonomy (CLAWP-104 audit)
prd.body_markdown:
## Objective
`clawpm reflect summarize` reports a real calibration scorecard (Brier, calibration curve, overconfidence, log-MAE, bias, learning velocity, miss-category distribution, closure) computed deterministically from the reflection JSONL, with formulas defined once in docs/design/calibration-metrics-spec.md and shared with the gbrain bridge.

## Why
CLAWP-104 audit. Measured 2026-09-02: 395 non-voided task_done events, 226 usable duration pairs, median actual/predicted 0.13 with a wall-clock tail to 977x, confidence 1-5 showing zero discrimination on duration, complexity_match tautological (100%), no pre-registration record, no closure rate. The existing summarize reports only duration ratios.

## Constraints
- Pure arithmetic over JSONL; no model calls; offline (gbrain unreachable).
- Forward-only ledger changes; no rewrite of historical events; no backfill of miss_category.
- Every metric cell gates on n>=20 and returns insufficient_data below it.
- Probability map and resolution rules live only in the spec; code cites the section.

## Out of scope
- Pre-authorisation lanes implementation (spec section 2.7 only).
- gbrain bridge and takes backfill (cognition-layer COGNI-007 / COGNI-002).
- Weekly operator surface cadence (weekly-memory-review integration) - a later leaf once scorecard exists.

## Success definition
Spec section 4 criteria 1-5 hold on the real portfolio and on synthetic fixtures.

## Chosen approach
Spec sections 2.1-2.6.

## Open questions
- If confidence shows no discrimination against held after M4 lands, propose retiring or redefining the field (research entry, not a leaf).

## Traceability
Ground: reflect.py, models.py, cli/reflect.py, cli/tasks.py read at fork/main 06a32b7; corpus probed with a disposable script (numbers in spec section 1); gbrain formulas read from garrytan/gbrain src/core/ops/takes.ts. UNGROUNDED-GRAPH effort tags.

leaves.title: Predictions are pre-registered: prediction_id + prediction_registered/prediction_revised events, closure computable

success_criteria.criterion: WHEN predictions are first written by tasks add, tasks predict, or emit-tree THEN predictions.prediction_id (uuid4 hex) is stored in frontmatter and a prediction_registered event with the snapshot, registered_at, filled_by, baseline_ref is appended to the task's reflection JSONL
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: tests per write site asserting frontmatter and JSONL line

success_criteria.criterion: WHEN tasks edit changes any predictions field THEN a prediction_revised event with the full new snapshot is appended and unrelated prediction fields are preserved (CLAWP-108 fixed or covered by a failing-then-passing test)
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: edit round-trip test

success_criteria.criterion: WHEN task_done or task_blocked events are written THEN they carry prediction_id; legacy events without it are read as legacy: true registered at created
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: reader tests on mixed fixtures

success_criteria.criterion: WHEN a synthetic corpus has 10 registered and 6 resolved non-voided predictions THEN closure reads 0.6 with open_predictions 4
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: unit test on the closure function (consumed by M4)

stop_conditions: If the concurrency lock (append_jsonl_line) cannot be used from the tasks add path without a circular import, STOP and report; do not write unlocked.

predictions.approach: Mint id in Predictions post-init when absent (persisted on first save); one helper write_prediction_event(event, ...) in reflect.py used by all three write sites; done/blocked events read prediction_id from the task. UNGROUNDED-GRAPH effort.
predictions.pre_mortem: Three write sites means one gets missed (likely emit-tree); the per-site tests are the guard.

leaves.title: Actuals are honest: active_min from work_log gaps; actuals.complexity only from --actual-complexity

success_criteria.criterion: WHEN a task has work_log entries THEN actuals.active_min = sum of min(gap_to_next, 60) over consecutive entries plus 15 for the last, and active_min <= duration_min on every real corpus event
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: unit test with a hand-built log; property check over ~/clawpm/reflections replayed from a fixture copy

success_criteria.criterion: WHEN done runs without --actual-complexity THEN actuals.complexity is null and deltas.complexity_match is null; WHEN given THEN complexity_match compares prediction to the supplied value
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: CLI tests both branches; test_reflect_phase1 updated to the new contract

success_criteria.criterion: reflect summarize and find_reference_tasks read active_min when present and fall back to duration_min, reporting which was used
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: summarize output field duration_source in {active,wallclock}

stop_conditions: If the 60-minute gap cap has to be configurable to make tests meaningful, STOP: it is a constant in the spec; propose a spec change instead.

predictions.approach: Extend _compute_actuals with the gap sum; add Actuals.active_min; remove task_complexity passthrough; new --actual-complexity option threaded to the transition. UNGROUNDED-GRAPH effort.
predictions.pre_mortem: Removing the complexity passthrough breaks tests that asserted the tautology; update them, don't keep the tautology.

leaves.title: Misses get a root cause: --miss-category on done, validated six-value taxonomy, nudge on unclassified miss

success_criteria.criterion: WHEN done --miss-category <c> runs THEN task_done carries miss_category=c for c in {wrong_signal, wrong_weight, missed_variable, operator_override, noise, structural}; any other value is rejected with bad_miss_category and nothing is written
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: CLI tests valid/invalid

success_criteria.criterion: WHEN the derived held outcome is incorrect and no --miss-category was given THEN done prints a one-line nudge listing the six values and still closes the task; WHEN held is correct or unresolvable THEN no nudge
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: output tests for the three branches

success_criteria.criterion: surprise_taxonomy behaviour is unchanged and both fields may be set on the same event
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: existing test_reflection_phase1_5 green plus a combined test

stop_conditions: If computing held at done-time requires the full metrics module from M4, STOP and implement only the per-axis resolution function from spec 2.1 here (M4 imports it).

predictions.approach: MISS_CATEGORIES frozenset next to SURPRISE_TAXONOMY; resolve_axes(predictions, actuals, deltas) -> per-axis + held per spec 2.1, living in reflect.py so M4 reuses it; nudge via click.echo to stderr in text mode, a warnings field in JSON mode. UNGROUNDED-GRAPH effort.
predictions.pre_mortem: The nudge becomes a blocking prompt; agent closes must stay non-interactive.

leaves.title: reflect summarize reports the calibration block (spec 2.3) and reflect scorecard renders it in five lines

success_criteria.criterion: WHEN reflect summarize runs THEN JSON contains calibration with brier, calibration_curve, overconfidence_ratio, mae_log, bias{factor,direction}, bucket_bias_factor, learning_velocity{90d,365d}, miss_category_distribution, metareflection_due, closure{rate,open_predictions,void_rate}; every cell has n and either values or insufficient_data: true when n<20
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: schema test on a synthetic corpus; run on the real portfolio exits 0

success_criteria.criterion: WHEN the synthetic corpus has hand-computed expected values (documented in the test) THEN brier, mae_log, bias.factor, overconfidence_ratio and closure match to 4 decimal places using the confidence->p map from spec 2.2
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: golden-value unit tests

success_criteria.criterion: WHEN the same miss_category appears >=3 times in the trailing 30 days within one project THEN metareflection_due lists {project_id, miss_category, count}; 2 occurrences or a 31-day spread do not
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: boundary tests

success_criteria.criterion: WHEN reflect scorecard runs THEN it prints exactly five lines: closure, bias factor, Brier+n, overconfidence headline, top miss category / metareflection due; --json returns the calibration block
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: output test

success_criteria.criterion: kind:decision events are excluded from the duration axis by default and included with --include-decisions
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: flag test

stop_conditions: If M1, M2 or M3 have not merged, STOP: this leaf consumes prediction_id/closure, active_min and resolve_axes.
If any formula needs a definition not in spec 2.3, STOP and propose the spec change rather than inventing it in code.

predictions.approach: New module clawpm/calibration.py (pure functions over event lists) called from summarize_calibration; scorecard command in cli/reflect.py; synthetic corpus builder in tests with documented expected numbers. UNGROUNDED-GRAPH effort.
predictions.pre_mortem: Learning velocity gets implemented on 30-day windows because it is natural; the spec forbids it at current volume.

leaves.title: Calibration signals reach the agent: Stop-hook and done output surface metareflection_due and a closure alarm below 0.6

success_criteria.criterion: WHEN the current project has a metareflection_due entry THEN clawpm hook eval-stop output and clawpm done text output include one line naming the category and count; WHEN none THEN no line
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: hook and CLI output tests

success_criteria.criterion: WHEN rolling-30-day closure < 0.6 for the portfolio THEN reflect summarize and scorecard include an alarm string; the threshold is a named constant cited to spec 2.3
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: boundary test at 0.59/0.60

success_criteria.criterion: Nudges never change exit codes or block a transition
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: exit-code assertions in the same tests

stop_conditions: If computing metareflection_due inside the Stop hook exceeds ~200ms on the real portfolio, STOP and cache it in the summarize output file instead of recomputing per stop.

predictions.approach: Reuse M4 functions; hook path already fail-open. UNGROUNDED-GRAPH effort.

leaves.title: The calibration layer is documented: SKILL.md reflection section, CLAUDE.md task discipline, COGNI-007 cross-reference

success_criteria.criterion: skills/clawpm/SKILL.md reflection section documents --miss-category (with the six meanings and the noise-is-valid rule), --actual-complexity, --resolution, reflect scorecard, and links docs/design/calibration-metrics-spec.md
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: section present; every flag named exists in the CLI (--help grep)

success_criteria.criterion: cognition-layer COGNI-007 task notes reference the spec sections 2.1-2.3 and 2.8 as the shared definitions for the gbrain bridge
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: note appended via clawpm log or tasks edit on COGNI-007 in F:/Git/cognition-layer

stop_conditions: If M3/M4 flags differ from the spec names, STOP and reconcile the spec first; docs follow the CLI.

predictions.pre_mortem: Written before the CLI settles and drifts; sequence last.
